bank.q: Which gives a random int 1 to 6?
Explain what a token and a delimiter are.
bank.model: A token is a piece of the string; a delimiter is a character that separates tokens (space by default).

bank.q: Why is Math.pow(2,3) not assignable to an int directly?
bank.model: It returns a double, so you must cast: (int) Math.pow(2,3).

bank.title: Mini project: CSV total
bank.brief: Given the line 'milk,12.50,bread,8.00,eggs,30.25' use StringTokenizer to split on commas and add up every price (the numbers) printing the total to 2 decimals.
